name: Dynamic Island — By Lxe Soul
description: Floating ultra-transparent glass Dynamic Island for GNOME Shell 50.1 on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS — By Lxe Soul. Features Classic Black hardware capsule when idle, song-reactive dynamic theming, circular song banner artwork, MPRIS controls (Spotify & browser sessions), PipeWire/Gvc audio mixer, backlight brightness, Quick Settings, live Blur tuner, and Pomodoro/Clipboard studio.
